2607.09133.title: IB-Flow: Information Bottleneck-Guided CFG Distillation for Few-Step Text-to-Image Generation
2607.09133.paper_summary: While large-scale text-to-image generative models have achieved unprecedented visual performance, their inherent reliance on multi-step iterative solvers incurs severe inference latency. Few-step distillation targeting the Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) trajectory has emerged as the prevalent dual-dimensional compression paradigm. However, existing frameworks remain subjugated by a coarse-grained blind injection paradigm that perpetually enforces a globally static guidance strength while indiscriminately sampling the supervisor timestep. This state-agnostic design completely disregards the intrinsic nature of image generation as a dynamic evolutionary process characterized by progressive entropy reduction, which not only restricts the performance boundary of few-step compression but also precipitates severe CFG over-conditioning artifacts. To transcend these limitations, we re-examine the distillation procedure through the theoretical lens of Information Theory, formally modeling it as a dynamic mutual information game constrained by the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle. Specifically, we dismantle traditional blind assumptions via a dual-track adaptive framework. To determine the injection target, we propose an instance-aware selection mechanism that transmutes the intractable KL divergence constraint into a zero-overhead closed-form solution predicated on the local vector field norm. To regulate the injection strength, we introduce an entropy-aware schedule that dynamically decays alongside the SNR, applying maximal thrust for initial structural anchoring before smoothly reverting to the natural manifold to refine micro-details. Extensive empirical evaluations corroborate that our framework fundamentally eradicates over-conditioning artifacts, shattering the performance ceiling to achieve SOTA generative fidelity under extremely stringent 2-step configurations.
2607.09133.paper_summary_zh: 雖然大規模的文本到圖像生成模型已達到前所未有的視覺性能，但它們固有的依賴多步迭代求解器會導致嚴重的推斷延遲。針對無分類器引導（CFG）軌跡的少步蒸餾已成為普遍的雙維壓縮範式。然而，現有框架仍然受制於一種粗糙的盲注入範式，這種範式不斷強制執行全球靜態的引導強度，同時不加區別地抽樣監督時間步。這種與狀態無關的設計完全忽視了圖像生成作為一個動態演化過程的內在特性，這一過程的特徵是逐步熵的減少，這不僅限制了少步壓縮的性能邊界，還導致了嚴重的CFG過度條件化伪影。為了超越這些限制，我們從信息理論的理論視角重新審視蒸餾過程，正式將其建模為一個受信息瓶頸（IB）原則約束的動態互信息博弈。具體而言，我們通過雙軌自適應框架拆解傳統的盲假設。為了確定注入目標，我們提出了一種基於實例的選擇機制，將難以處理的KL散度約束轉化為基於局部向量場範數的零開銷封閉形式解決方案。為了調節注入強度，我們引入了一種熵感知調度，該調度隨著信噪比動態衰減，初始結構固定時施加最大推力，然後平滑地回歸到自然流形以細化微觀細節。大量實證評估證實，我們的框架從根本上消除了過度條件化伪影，打破了性能上限，以在極其嚴格的2步配置下實現SOTA生成保真度。
